Ice Cream Sundae Sandwiches
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 14, 2009 - 12:41am

Ingredients




1 cup shredded coconut
1 pkt nut topping - (2 oz)
(available on baking aisle)
1 cup mini chocolate chips
8 scoop vanilla or fudge swirl 16 chocolate or chocolate 
Preparation

1 Mix coconut, nuts and mini chips in a shallow dish. 2 Scoop balls of ice cream onto 8 cookies. Top with a second cookie each and gently press down until ice cream comes to the edges of the cookies. Make sandwiches 1 1/2 to 2 inches thick. 3 Roll ice cream in coconut, nut and chip topping and serve. 4 This recipe yields 8 mini ice cream sundae sandwiches.
